apps.subtitle: On-device iOS app signer and installer
apps.localizedDescription: RyukSign is an on-device app signer and installer for iOS, derived from Feather (by claration). Sign and install apps with a .p12 / .mobileprovision pair, manage tweaks (.dylib/.deb/.framework/.bundle/.appex), transfer files over HTTP/WebDAV, and track app updates — entirely on-device.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new in 4.2.0

### New

- Added on-device pairing on iOS 27, no computer needed for a pairing file
- Added certificate reordering with Move to Top, used everywhere you pick a certificate
- Added certificate search
- Added Japanese translation by @kinboy56

### Improvements

- Improved installs to show progress while the app is sent to iOS

### Fixes

- Fixed installs failing after the SSL certificate renews
- Fixed installs staying stuck halfway when iOS hides install progress
- Fixed untranslated text in the Tweak Manager


**Full changelog:** https://github.com/faroukbmiled/RyukSign/compare/v4.1.0...v4.2.0
